name: reveal-on-scroll
title: Reveal on scroll
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Fades, slides, or scales in once when it enters the viewport.

meta.descriptionEs: Entra con fade, slide o scale al llegar al viewport. Una vez.

examples.title: Revelar al desplazar
examples.description: Entra con fade, slide o scale al llegar al viewport.

examples.title: Glosario
examples.description: Los seis términos de scroll, con demos propias.

api.name: once
api.description: Reveal a single time. Default true.

api.name: amount
api.description: How much of the element must be visible. Default 0.3.

api.name: root
api.description: Scroll root. Defaults to the viewport.

api.name: delay / className
api.description: Delay in seconds, and classes for the wrapper.

docs: Clean-room viewport entrance. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. in-view-title remains the title-only reveal. Reduced motion shows the content immediately, using motion-preference. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite motion-preference, motion.ts, or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
